names.note: Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's second heading for the Julian 11 April on pravoslavno.rs, „Св. муч. Прокес и Мартинијан.“, where Св. муч. heads the pair and belongs to neither name, so each forename stands bare. The heading gives him no epithet; «the Jailer» in the English name is what the entry's first sentence says the two men were, and the corpus keeps such a clause in the display name. No other folder holds a Serbian Прокес.

Read out of the title on the name link behind his place in the line for 11 апреля ст. ст., name page 1837, «Прокесс Римский, мч.», with the rank word left off. The day’s own line gives the name in the genitive. `.tmp/sr-foldpred.mjs` reports the stored form as a key no other folder holds.

attestations.note: The day's second entry, an enumerated pair of two names, so two folders. **This is a new folder and not an upgrade, checked.** The corpus holds no `processus` of any spelling — `grep -rli processus saints/*/saint.json` names five folders and every one of them is somebody else's life mentioning a jailer — and the six folders whose names read near Martinian's are other men: `martinian-of-caesarea` is the ascetic of 13 February with Zoe, `martinian-of-ephesus` one of the Seven Sleepers' day, `martinian-of-white-lake` and `martinian-of-zographou` are later monastics, `martinianus-of-areobindus` is the Greek 18 May, and `galaction-disciple-of-martinian` is named after yet another. None is a jailer and none is Roman. **The whole of what this source gives them is five sentences**, and the life says so: they were jailers at the Roman prison where the apostles Peter and Paul were held; hearing the apostles' words and seeing their wonders they were baptised and let them out; the apostles left Rome, the Lord met Peter on the road, the «Quo vadis» answer sent them back ashamed, and they were taken and killed — and these two brave martyrs were beheaded with them. **No year**: the entry gives none and none was inferred from the apostles' deaths. **No `locations`**: Rome is named, but a located folder with no `dates` goes on `tests/map-span.test.mjs`'s UNDATED list, and the gain would be nothing. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru’s life: «Святые Прокесс и Мартиниан были усечены мечом (+ ок. 67)», and the day line closes «(ок. 67)». The folder stood undated because the Ohrid Prologue it was written from printed no year at all, so nothing is displaced. Read 7 October 2026.
